test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

After working so much / in the fields yesterday, / did you took a break?
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** "did you took a break."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the incorrect use of the past tense verb **"took."**
 
• The correct form of the verb to use after the auxiliary verb **"did"** is the base form of the verb, which is** "take."**
 
• The verb** "took" **is in the past tense, but it should be in the base form **"take"** because **"did"** already indicates past tense.
 
• The correct sentence should be *"After working so much in the fields yesterday, **did you take a break**__?"*
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
